newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toco gets winding-up order for Inn unit.
newsitem.headline: Toco gets winding-up order for Inn unit.

text.p: Industrial holding company Toco Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had received an urgent provisional winding-up order for one of its subsidiaries, Inn Group Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
Toco said the order was received on Wednesday.
Full details of the effect on the earnings and asset value on Toco will be disclosed when the company published its year results at the end of June.
Toco advised shareholders to exercise caution in dealings until the publication of results.
